title: Upread v1 (1 of 2): reader, manifest and article extraction
task:
Build the first half of Upread: a Vite + TypeScript Home Screen web app. Keep it small and write files early; do not audit dependency source.

Reader (src/): dark screen showing one word at a time, large and centred, with one red pivot letter about 35% into each word held at a fixed position. Speed slider 150-900 wpm, default 300, remembered in localStorage. Pauses: 1.5x after commas, 2x after sentence ends, longer for words over 8 letters. Tap to pause, swipe left to go back one sentence, draggable progress bar. A text box to paste a link; the app posts it to /api/extract and reads the returned text.

public/manifest.webmanifest: name "Upread", display "standalone"; linked from index.html.

api/extract.ts: a Vercel function that takes a URL, fetches the page server-side and returns only the article text, using @mozilla/readability with linkedom as the DOM. HTML pages only.

Tests (npm test runs vitest, offline): the tokenizer, pause timing, and article extraction on a bundled sample HTML page under test/fixtures/.

.gitignore lists node_modules and dist; neither is committed.

Out of scope (a later ticket): PDFs and pdf.js. Do not install pdfjs-dist.
